cohort: The study included pregnancies lasting >22 weeks of gestation in women aged 18-43 years between 2013 and 2019, recorded in the French health data warehouse.
finding: Pregnancies exposed to clomiphene citrate had a fourfold higher risk of multiple gestation births and were associated with significantly more adverse obstetric and perinatal outcomes, even in singleton pregnancies, compared to unexposed pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women exposed to clomiphene citrate presented a significantly higher cesarean section rate as one of the adverse perinatal outcomes.
